examples.title: String art
examples.description: Builds two curves out of straight lines in SCREEN 2, adds a yellow disc and writes on the picture through the GRP: device; press any key to return to BASIC.

examples.title: Your name backwards
examples.description: Asks for your name, counts its letters and spells it backwards one character at a time with MID$.

examples.title: Reaction test
examples.description: Wait for the screen to turn red, then press Space as quickly as you can; the TIME counter measures you, and Space starts the next round.
